DEFINITION · qeva:1:conjunction@1

Conjunction

Conjunction joins requirements that must hold together.

editoriallogic
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

Conjunction joins requirements that must hold together.

EXACT

The compact statement

P∧Q is true in classical semantics exactly when both P and Q are true; proof systems specify introduction and elimination rules.

Example

‘n is positive and even’ combines two conditions.

Boundary / caveat

The connective's exact behavior is set by its logic, not by typography alone.

Assumptions

  • The declared propositional language context is fixed.
